description:
HushGram v0.0.5 targets Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 (com.instagram.android) with 48 patches, two more than the last release. The new ones hide the notes row at the top of your messages and add View DM photos and videos anonymously. Both start off until you turn them on.

Read Before you sign in in the README first. A re-signed Instagram can't pass Google's Play Store check whatever the patches do. Sign in with a spare account if you can, and don't clear the app's data afterward.

Validation: 1491 runtime tests passed locally. All 686 patch tests passed too. All 48 patches applied to Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a build of Instagram 449.0.0.52.84, version code 385511871. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. Keep the manager's signing key for updates, so a new build installs over the old one and you stay signed in.
